reasons.evidence:
Thank you for being clear about what you saw—I can help sort out whether your account is showing “Planner Pro,” but I can’t directly verify your current subscription or billing status. Here’s what you can do right now, based on the free and paid tiers we have:

**First check in TableCards**
1. Open your account (the same place you signed up) and go to **Account** or **Settings**.
2. Look for a section like “Plan” or “Billing,” where it will show your current status:
   - Free ($0)
   - Event Pass
   - Planner Pro
   - Studio (if you have it too)
3. Recent charges and renewal dates will appear in the same billing area. If you see a charge here, you did subscribe for this period.

If you see an active subscription and you don’t want it
- In the billing/settings area, you should be able to downgrade to the Free plan (or cancel entirely). The UI options will differ slightly, but look for “Downgrade,” “Change plan,” or “Cancel subscription.”

If you don’t see any active subscription or billing info
- Use the **Help / Contact** link on the site, include your email, and attach any screenshots (like the email or the “Planner Pro” message). A human can verify what’s happening on the account side and confirm whether any payment was taken.

**What the tiers are**
- Free: $0, 1 active project, up to 25 cards, 3 predefined designs, 1 lifetime welcome AI batch.
- Event Pass: $5 one-time, 1 event up to 500 cards, full premium predefined designs, event‑only artwork uploads, 2 AI batches; meant for a single event.
- Planner Pro: $9/month (per the launch tier list), up to 25 active projects, reusable custom presets, copying, 10 AI batches/month. Monthly AI batches never roll over; no annual or per‑seat charges seen so far.

**A few things I can’t confirm**
- Whether a specific charge was actually applied to your payment method—at that point you’d rely on your bank statement or the billing center.
- details about upcoming renewal timing—this is in your Account/Billing section.
- refunds or changes to your account beyond what you can do yourself.

Next step
- Sign into TableCards, check your plan page and billing history.
- If you’re still unsure, use **Help / Contact** and attach relevant screenshots and your email address; they can verify exactly what your account shows and what happened.

If you’d like, you can reply with what you see in your account (plan name, any associated dates or amounts), and I can walk you through the most likely next move.
